channel.title: Lucas Linkowski Blog
channel.description: Technical writing on malware analysis, reverse engineering, detection engineering, and GenAI in cybersecurity.

item.title: Are You Actually Using the Model You Selected?
item.description: A model picker or an API response that repeats the model name is not proof of which model handled the request. For hosted models you cannot hash production weights, so the practical approach is a transaction evidence chain.

item.title: Speak LLM: A Practical Glossary for Better Agent Outcomes
item.description: A practical glossary of agent and LLM workflow phrases such as smoke test, blast radius, regression, harness, and negative path, with ready-to-paste prompts.

item.title: The Token Problem: KV Cache, Prefill Cost, and Coding Agents
item.description: Why a short prompt can still burn a full context window: how KV cache, prefill, decode, and multi-turn agent harnesses drive token cost and usage-based pricing.

item.title: Prompt Smarter: Leveraging LLM Insights for Enhanced Outcomes
item.description: How LLMs process prompts through tokenisation, embeddings, attention, prediction, and sampling, and how that connects to prompt structure, temperature, and agent harnesses.

item.title: Token Use Optimizations: How to keep agent sessions fast, cheap, and useful
item.description: Agentic tool sessions become expensive when conversation history, file reads, shell output, skills and responses accumulate. Token optimisation tips for agentic CLI work.

item.title: Token Economics: Best practices for managing context windows
item.description: Claude Code and other agentic CLI tools re-evaluate the full context window on every turn. Techniques for managing context pressure and reducing token waste.

item.title: Agent Harnesses, Skills, and Tool Runtimes: The Architecture of Frontier Models
item.description: A long form guide to agent harnesses, skills, MCP servers, tool runtimes, and the system design choices that turn frontier models into real task systems.

item.title: Zero-Day Discovery at Machine Speed and the Defensive Shift Ahead
item.description: Anthropic reports frontier LLMs achieving autonomous zero day discovery and exploitation. Defenders need agentic security workflows and memory safe architectures.

item.title: The Evolution of Social Engineering: Weaponizing Web Lures Against Agentic AI
item.description: How cybercriminals are adapting SocGholish and ClickFix campaigns to target autonomous AI agents through Indirect Prompt Injection and the Parallel-Poisoned Web.

item.title: Building an MCP Server for Malware Traffic Analysis
item.description: How I connected Fiddler traffic capture to an LLM with MCP, then moved execution control into a Python harness.

item.title: Detecting AI Prompt Injection in the Wild
item.description: Detection patterns for indirect prompt injection, AI ClickFix for computer-use agents, CSS hidden text traps, HashJack fragments, and credential exfiltration targeting autonomous AI agents.

item.title: Cognitive Induction Prompting: Reverse-Engineering How LLMs Process Your Prompts
item.description: A deep dive into the 5-step LLM generation pipeline and how understanding tokenisation, embeddings, attention, prediction, and sampling transforms prompting from guesswork into deliberate control.
